title: Parafly
description: ParaFly is a lightweight Paper 1.21.x plugin that gives players claim-bound flight through GriefPrevention. Anyone with the permission automatically starts flying the moment they enter a claim they own or are trusted in, and loses flight when they leave
body:
ParaFly lets players fly but only inside the GriefPrevention claims they own or are
trusted in. Flight switches on automatically as a player enters their claim and off as they
leave, with a notification each time. A flying player is held at the claim border so they
can't fly out into the wild, and each player can toggle the feature for themselves with
`/claimfly`. Players who can already fly elsewhere (creative, spectator, or another fly
plugin) are never affected.
